responsibility: This header declares the C interface for gm2 statement and function-body lowering. It provides prototypes for function start/end handling, assignments, labels and gotos, calls and parameter lists, return generation, jumps, cleanup/try-finally helpers, inline asm, set update operations, and module init helpers, corresponding to the statement-construction logic in m2statement.cc.
same_name_distinction: C/C++ header for the m2statement group: it declares the native lowering interface for statements and function bodies, while m2statement.def is the Modula-2-side foreign view and m2statement.cc contains the executable construction code.
